Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL4649965. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then join compound_structures on molregno to enforce structure presence. Filter by assay CHEMBL4649965, standard_value not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
